sections.Profile:
The "Kings" pinball machine, released by Williams Manufacturing Company in 1957, is a single-player electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Williams, with artwork by George Molentin. This machine features two flippers, three pop bumpers, five passive bumpers, two slingshots, and two gobble holes.
